propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the five workstreams of a software company's data platform migration for two years under the company's delivery method with the migration plan and the cut-over schedule, and prepared the weekly steering report for the head of data platform.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the plan and the steering report document the workstreams and the reporting.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate managed dependencies with the data engineering and analytics teams through the method's dependency register and prepared the cut-over readiness review for each of the eleven cut-overs, with the cut-over approval staying with the head of data platform and the check split recorded.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the readiness review and the reference call document the dependency work and the approval boundary.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the closure report for each workstream with the boundary statement and the acceptance evidence signed by the analytics team leads.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the closure report document the closure documents.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the workstreams, the reporting, the dependency work, the approval boundary and the closure reports.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the approval boundary as documented: readiness reviews by the candidate, cut-over approvals by the head of data platform; the packet makes no judgement.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the migration folder references so the cut-over approval records can be checked.
